Lets send this Brute back to where it came from!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 25 (Formerly, [[Easy Mode|Easy]]))}} }} ==Description== The '''Brute''' is the final boss of [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode and one of the [[Challenge Trials]] mini-bosses. It also appeared in [[The Takeover Event]]. For most of its appearances it is a [[Boss]] enemy, making it have various resistances and immunities, which includes being resistant to stuns from stunning towers, immune to being frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Electroshocker]] confused by the [[Jester]], damaged from the [[Nuke]]'s fallout and slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. Unlike most other final bosses however, it is not considered one by default, meaning there are some circumstances where it lacks these immunities. The '''Brute''' has very high health compared to anything that spawns before, but to compensate, it walks very slowly. It has two abilities. Its first, ''Smash'', in which it slams its fists onto a tower or unit, stunning it and other nearby towers for 3 seconds and doing 1,000 damage to units. Its second, ''Throw'', has it throw a rock at a nearby tower or unit, which then splits into four smaller rocks. Each rock stuns towers for 5 seconds and does 500 damage to units per rock. It is completely unable to use any of these abilities in [[PVP]]. ==Appearance== The '''Brute''' is a large hulking humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a pale green skin color, an orange torso, waist and legs, with the former having white stripes. It wears black shoes and has a black harness with white buckles. It also has black braces with white spikes and chains attached, along with indented lower arms. It also has two heads, with the left one being larger. Whenever one of its fists hits the ground, the screen shakes and makes a stomp sound. On death, the '''Brute''' will repeatedly bang its lower arms on its chest before falling forward onto the ground. ==Strategy== *As the '''Brute''' has the lowest health out of all main final bosses, starter towers like the [[Sniper]], [[Soldier]] or [[Shotgunner]] are capable of defeating it. **The [[Sniper]] can especially be a decent option due to its [[Stun Immunity]] gained from being a cliff tower. ***Since this is the cliff [[Stun Immunity]], it also means that the [[Sniper]] can be used as a distraction due to it still being targetable by enemy abilities. **Strong DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]] can also be used against it, though they are not necessary outside of [[Challenge Trials]]. **As the '''Brute''' only has stunning attacks, splash damage towers like the [[Demoman]] are not particularly useful against the '''Brute'''. *You can place down towers like the [[Scout]] or use a unit spawner like the [[Crook Boss]] to create distractions which the '''Brute''' will target instead of your DPS towers, though this is not necessary due to its rather low health. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} Brutewalk.gif|Current walk animation (26 February 2025 – Present) Brutesmash.gif|Current ''Smash'' animation (26 February 2025 – Present) Brutethrow.gif|Current ''Throw'' animation (26 February 2025 – Present) Brutedeathanimation.gif|Current death animation (26 February 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDummyBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BruteThumbnail.png|'''Brute''' on the game thumbnail.
